exit_plan.note: 2029 exit plan: at least half the portfolio moves into income funds. Miner net yield on 2029 value is ~3.7% (after ~16.15% NR301 withholding on the THX CAD dividend, not reclaimable in ISA/SIPP), so any fund yield above that raises income while shedding single-name and pre-production risk. Terminal value dominates: bear-bull swings 2029 income by ~GBP 64k vs ~GBP 8k across the whole transfer/yield grid. Edit transfer_share (0-1) and fund_yield (0-1) to re-plan.
